rules.label: Connected partner capabilities
rules.description: Use training and resources in your partner’s territory when you can get there and back. Required tasks and places you roll from still come from your own reachable map.

rules.label: Saved selected candidates
rules.description: Include the rolling member’s manually selected candidate chunks from the original picker.

rules.label: Adjacent chunks
rules.description: Include neighbouring chunks you can enter from your own reachable unlocked terrain. Frontier mode includes neighbours on the grid even without a verified walking connection.

rules.label: Neighbor candidate mode
rules.description: Accessible includes neighbours with a recorded walking connection from reachable unlocked terrain and is the default. Manual uses your selected chunks. Frontier includes grid neighbours even without a walking connection. Free-to-play rules still apply.

rules.label: Clear selected candidates after roll
rules.description: After a rolled chunk is unlocked, clear the rolling member’s remaining manually selected candidates. Pending offers and cancellations retain selections.

rules.label: Walkable generated candidates
rules.description: In Frontier mode, only add neighbouring chunks marked walkable. Accessible mode checks recorded walking connections instead. Manually selected chunks bypass this filter.

rules.label: Automatic teleport and transport availability
rules.description: Check your travel options using synced levels and quests, obtainable supplies and lodestones. Without synced levels, the highest level you can train to is an estimate. Destinations stay locked until you unlock them.

rules.label: Admit verified transport routes
rules.description: Use verified boats, teleports and other transport to reach areas and add roll candidates. You must meet the personal levels, quests, item and fare requirements. Partner resources require a route back. Travel does not change chunk ownership or walking connections.

rules.label: Usable teleport destinations
rules.description: An available teleport adds a destination to the roll pool without unlocking it.

rules.label: Teleport availability scope
rules.description: Personal uses only the rolling member’s usable teleports; group is an optional house rule.

rules.label: Allow consumable teleports
rules.description: Include usable teleports that consume runes, tablets or charges.

rules.label: Free-to-play generated candidates
rules.description: Only add free-to-play terrain to the roll pool. Chunks with both free and members areas need a free entry area. Manually selected chunks bypass this filter.

rules.label: Task completion scope
rules.description: Any member, every member, or the current member may satisfy a task; personal records remain separate.

rules.label: Cache skill-guide tasks
rules.description: Add reviewed skill-guide actions from the game files when their locations and requirements are verified. Level-only milestones need the separate optional milestone rule.

rules.label: Reviewed skill-guide and combat corrections
rules.description: Apply reviewed task membership and numeric level corrections supported by cache and Wiki evidence.

rules.label: Optional skill-guide milestones
rules.description: With Cache skill-guide tasks enabled, also make informational thresholds such as standard no-burn cooking levels optional goals. These thresholds produce no item and remain in the guide catalogue when disabled.

policy.optionA: Fixed bank services made available by membership; ordinary walking or retained F2P transport; all F2P quests completed; no members quest or members-only skill prerequisite. Unknown finishing levels, achievements, payments, builds, roaming banker presence and members transports are separate conditional lists.
policy.optionB: Havenhythe full banks usable after F2P preparation. Wendlewick is baseline; Dalia requires confirmation of the F2P Trader Woes achievement. Members-quest banks are inventory only until their gates are satisfied.
policy.chunkIdMeaning: Displayed surface chunk containing bank, or explicitly named surface entry parent for a connected interior. Interior source-region IDs and cache map IDs are not interchangeable with these IDs.
policy.weighting: Roll unique chunkId values. Multiple services within the same chunk do not add weight unless deliberately chosen.
policy.personalEligibility: Check each player independently. F2P completion does not prove maximum skill levels or every achievement.

optionA.requirementsNote: Walk to the surface chest. No Divination level or quest gate; Hall of Memories requirements apply to different content.
Walk to the surface camp. The 76 Archaeology requirement gates underground excavation, not this bank chest.
Walk into the lobby. No quest, skill requirement or game participation needed for the chest.
Walk into the Stronghold and upstairs to the bank. No quest or Agility gate.
Walk to the Grand Tree and climb to its banks. The Grand Tree quest is not required.
Walk to the exterior chest. Bar Crawl requirements apply to the agility course, not the bank.
Ordinary walking access. No quest, Agility or guild requirement for Yanille bank.

optionA.place: North East Ardougne / Chaos Druid Tower chunk
optionA.requirementsNote: Ordinary walking access. The bank is outside the Chaos Druid Tower; its requirements do not apply.

optionA.place: Temple of Ikov surface / Ranging Guild chunk
optionA.bank: Stormguard Citadel surface camp bank chest
optionA.requirementsNote: Walk to Stormguard surface camp. The chest at (2674, 3405) is outside the Ranging Guild and the dig-site interior; neither 40 Ranged nor 70 Archaeology is needed.
Walk across White Wolf Mountain and through Catherby. No quest requirement.
Walk across White Wolf Mountain. Aggressive wolves are a hazard, not a level or quest gate.

Surface parent of the connected TzHaar City cavern. No members quest or skill gate for ordinary bankers. Internal source-region IDs are not separate surface starts. Reach Karamja using the retained F2P ship route if needed.
Surface parent of Rogues' Den, through the pub trapdoor. No Thieving, Agility or Herblore gate for Emerald Benedict; minigame requirements are separate.
Surface parent of Champions' Arena bank. Its 33 quest-point entry requirement is met by all F2P quests. No champion scroll or fight is required merely to use the chest.
Membership enables full bank opening. No quest, skill or item gate. The F2P healing/collection/preset functions do not make it a full F2P bank.
Membership required; the workshop need not be built. Other Fort bank services have separate quest/build gates.
Surface parent of Senntisten, entered through the Ancient door at (3332, 3452). No quest or 60 Archaeology gate for reaching the bank. This chunk also has a F2P campus bank.
Walk through Shantay Pass and across the River Elid. No quest or members transport required. Water and food are sensible desert preparation, not formal bank requirements.

optionAConditional.requirementsNote: 68 Fishing, achievable in F2P. Completing F2P quests does not prove this level; check each player before adding.

Surface parent of Eniola in Ourania Cave. Each bank opening costs 20 held runes of one type. F2P runes can pay; confirm supplies and that this payment is allowed. No members quest or skill gate identified.

Membership and Trader Woes completed. This F2P achievement requires Visions of Havenhythe and exactly 30 iron nails; it can be prepared before the reset. Confirm its completion separately from F2P quests.

Defeat the level-33 Paterdomus ghoul once and cross the holy barrier. Priest in Peril is an alternative, not mandatory. No members skill gate identified; confirm this one-time combat unlock or explicitly allow preparing it.

Defeat the Paterdomus ghoul for Morytania access. Walking via Canifis, Haunted Woods and the eastern coast is supported by Wiki directions; no Nature Spirit gate is needed on that route. The 42 Archaeology level gates excavation/fast travel, with no separate bank gate stated. Confirm the walking route and bank interaction before automatic selection; neither was visited.
